items.title: TikTok explores peer-to-peer payments via direct messages
items.summary: Investing.com -- TikTok is developing a feature that would enable users to send money to each other through direct messages, expanding the social media platform's entry into financial services, Bloomberg reported Tuesday.

items.title: Klarna Craters 19% on Guidance Cut While Affirm, PayPal Shrug It Off
items.summary: Klarna posted a Q2 beat and raised its profit outlook, yet the stock cratered while rivals shrugged. The reason behind that split tells a very different story than the headline numbers suggest.

items.title: Peter Thiel Places Big Bets on Energy, Amazon in Revamped Portfolio
items.summary: Thiel Macro is suddenly back in action with a roster that seems less concerned about an AI bubble, and more concerned with an AI bottleneck.

items.title: What Is PayPal Really Worth? Piper Sandler Sees Value Beyond Checkout Amid Stripe-Advent Bid
items.summary: Piper Sandler raised the price target on PayPal by more than 40% to $59 and maintained a ‘Neutral’ rating on the shares.

items.title: With industry consolidation looming, Block refreshes business payments
items.summary: The company's Square unit has upgraded its seller-focused credit card, adding incentives and linking to digital transfers rails. This comes as Stripe may acquire PayPal and AI developer OpenRouter.

items.title: Klarna Group Drops 7% Before Q2 Earnings, Sezzle Falls 5% as BNPL Names Diverge
items.summary: Klarna shares are shedding gains right before the BNPL firm's most watched earnings release since its IPO, and the moves rippling through Sezzle, Affirm, and PayPal tell very different stories about where investor conviction actually sits.

items.title: Stripe Purchase Of AI Firm OpenRouter Unlikely To Derail PayPal Deal
items.summary: PayPal stock dipped as analysts mulled how Stripe's OpenRouter purchase could impact a possible takeover of the payments firm.

items.title: Should You Buy, Sell or Hold PayPal Stock After a 36.1% 3-Month Rise?
items.summary: PYPL's 36.1% surge in three months reflects TPV and Venmo growth, but weak checkout growth and fierce competition raise questions about its recovery.
